messages.subject: For Karla Dorsch | Middle East Executive Search Introduction
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Elmore,

I attempted to reach Karla Dorsch in Dubai, but her mail gateway rejected the message. I am routing this introduction through you at NGS Global.

I serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG, social responsibility, external affairs, executive advisory and strategic stakeholder engagement. My work spans mining, energy transition, major-project coordination and senior institutional relationships.

I am internationally mobile, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE as priority markets, and I am open to senior mandates in ESG, external affairs, government relations, strategic partnerships and country leadership.

Executive profile: https://ragunauthramsaroop.com
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop

I would appreciate your forwarding this to Karla or the appropriate Middle East partner.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
